sentences.en: Nothing is more disappointing than to lose in the finals.
sentences.zh: 决赛输掉是最令人失望的事情。

sentences.en: It's always disappointing when you lose a match on penalties.
sentences.zh: 点球大战输掉总是让人感到很失望。

sentences.en: I found the book interesting, but the movie was disappointing.
sentences.zh: 我发现这本书挺有趣的，但电影却让人失望。

senses.zh: 令人失望的；令人扫兴的
令人失望（disappoint的ing形式）；辜负…的期望
